display_long_description:
Build Island is the BUILD brick builder set free on a bright tropical island.

BUILD TOGETHER
Up to eight builders share one giant stud plate. Every brick you set down appears on everyone's island the moment it lands, and when you join late the whole build is already there. Your own island stays saved on your headset while you visit a friend's.

REAL BUILDERS
Pick your avatar and the others see a full body: the head turns where they look, the arm reaches where they point, and a see-through brick floats where they are about to place it.

THE ROUND MENU
Press Y and the wheel opens in front of you: bricks, plates, slopes and twelve colours on four tabs. Bricks snap to the studs, stack, build out sideways and hang from the underside. A steady-aim laser means a shaking hand never puts a brick in the wrong place. A sets it down, trigger picks one up, B turns it, grip copies, X undoes.

THE ISLAND
A 64 metre plate on a lawn in the middle of white sand, with 120 palms, beach umbrellas, lifeguard towers, a walkable pier with sailboats, tiki torches, gulls and turquoise shallows fading into the deep blue sea.

ONE BUTTON TO PLAY ONLINE
QUICK JOIN builds with whoever is on, PRIVATE ISLAND gives your friends a 4-digit code. Voice chat is off by default. Mute, block or report anyone from the Builders list.

Your world saves by itself, a starter house is waiting on load, and five music tracks play while you build. Play alone whenever you like.
